   151	Furthermore, the CRM Plan section 5.1.2.16 detailed the requirement for the monthly review by
   152	only restating the regulation. The CRM Plan referenced a review of nuisance alarms under
   153	procedure “Nuisance Alarm Resolution Procedure.” False alarms are gathered under nuisance
   154	alarms. CRM Plan section 11.8 also restated the regulation and offered guidance on review of
   155	nuisance alarms. A review of the records identified four areas of review: (1) Key Performance
   156	Indicators (KPIs), (2) “Top 10 All Alarm Review,” (3) “Critical Alarm Review,” and (4) “Stale
   157	Alarm Review.” These reviews were not defined in a procedure in the CRM Plan. Therefore,
   158	NGL Supply failed to have, in practice, procedures to identify points affecting safety that have
   159	been taken off scan in the SCADA host, have had alarms inhibited, generated false alarms, or
   160	that have had forced or manual values for periods of time exceeding that required for associated
